context_line: Ressa can spot a false Ironbrand by the way its scar fails to pull when the bearer speaks.
dialogue_hostile: The Sentinels distrust your name. Ressa keeps the hot tongs between you and the rack.
dialogue_warm: The Sentinels trust your name. Ressa clears the sparks when you step to the rack.
hook_summary: Must inspect a suspect veteran's counterfeit brand.
